column1: # Per-agent picked models. The entries are the only catalog entries the
# agent's lists show after visible.tsv, as if "Only models I pick" were on.
# A group entry is written group/<id>; a model entry is provider/model.
# The deployment writes this list into Magpie's own settings
# (~/.config/magpie/settings.json, key pickedModels). Magpie has no CLI for an
# individual pick; the app's Agents page writes the same key when the operator
# ticks a model. The list is intent, so the repository owns it; the settings
# file itself stays device state and is never committed.
